summary: The media test suite gains broader coverage for AV1 Scalable Video Coding (SVC), including temporal IDs in bitstreams and automatic keyframes, along with controls for encoder bitrate modes and hardware preferences. New tests check color metadata through FFmpeg, VideoToolbox, and remote video transport, plus audio/video clock accuracy around seeks, playback drift, silence, and device output. The suite also covers shutdown message handling and audio-driver stream naming, helping catch timing, color, and teardown regressions before they reach users.
